title: Rubric Eval Result
description: One rubric (presence/sourcing) grading result for a single Wiki Output File (WOF). This is the rubric instance of a shared eval envelope: the FC eval uses eval="fc" with a flat summary, the GBF eval reuses the $defs below with a different status vocabulary. The rubric is all-model: every item has engine="model". Emitted files are plain JSON with no comments. The Pydantic v2 models in evals/rubric/models.py + evals/common/models.py are the real contract; this schema mirrors them.

eval.description: Which eval produced this file. Const "rubric" here so the rubric schema validates strictly; fc/gbf are sibling schemas that reuse the $defs below.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS envelope shape (not the rubric contents). Bump only when the envelope structure changes.

wof.description: Filename or path of the graded Wiki Output File. The join key that ties the fc/rubric/gbf results for one run together.

graded_at.description: UTC timestamp when this result was produced.

graders.description: Who/what produced the results. The rubric is all-model, so this is a single model grader (the rubric has no mechanical grader; whether the model actually ran is carried by summary.complete + item skipped status).

items.description: One entry per criterion evaluated (per-entity). Keyed by stable id (rubric.sections.*, rubric.presence.<category>.*, rubric.pc-stated.*, rubric.pc-marked.*, rubric.sourcing.<category>.*).

engine.description: Which engine judged this. The rubric only ever emits "model".

status.description: Result for one criterion. pass/fail as expected. partial = partially met; SCORES as a fail but kept visible. na = criterion does not apply to this WOF (e.g. sourcing for an absent entity — its presence item already failed); excluded from the denominator. skipped = not evaluated this run (the model was disabled/unavailable, or a check degraded); excluded from the denominator AND flips summary.complete to false.

evidence.description: Why the status was assigned. Required on every item.

lines.description: Line number(s) in the WOF the finding refers to. Empty for whole-document checks.

detail.description: A one-line rationale (for sourcing passes, names the backing footnote + the supporting span).

found.description: Optional. What was actually present (e.g. the supporting quote span).

id.description: Stable criterion id (dotted rubric.* slug). The ONLY join key; results reference the id, never the prose. Tokens embed entity slugs which may contain non-ASCII letters, so the pattern allows any non-dot, non-whitespace token.

description.description: Informational copy of the criterion text. NOT authoritative; the id wins. Safe to omit.

subscore.description: One bucket's applicable-only tally. No complete/skipped here — those are run-level on the summary.

partial.description: Counts toward fail in scoring; surfaced separately.

applicable.description: pass + partial + fail. The denominator (na and skipped excluded).

score.description: pass / applicable, in 0..1. null when applicable == 0.

summary.description: Two independent sub-scores under a run-level complete. There is no combined top score. items[] is the source of truth.

complete.description: false when any item was skipped (the model was off/unavailable, or a check degraded). Makes a provisional grade visibly provisional.

grader.description: A mechanical grader or a model grader, discriminated on engine. The rubric only emits a model grader.
